boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten named Sacred Heart spaces with documented ways students study, create, gather, recharge or reflect.

cards.title: Ryan Matura Library
cards.subtitle: Study, research and collaboration
cards.notes: Start here for a shared work session: choose a research task, use the library’s resources and check the current physical-space hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: The university describes the library as a gathering place for study, research and collaboration.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart identifies Ryan Matura Library as a gathering place for study, research and collaboration among the university community.
cards.access_notes: Check the library’s current hours page before visiting.

cards.title: Hawley Lounge
cards.subtitle: Between-class work and downtime
cards.notes: Use the gap between classes for a low-key reset: bring a laptop or meet a classmate, then leave time to reach your next commitment.
cards.short_summary: SHU’s commuter-life page names Hawley Lounge for relaxing, doing work and hanging out between classes.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says Hawley Lounge is a hub for relaxing, doing work and hanging out between classes.
cards.access_notes: Confirm building access and availability locally.

cards.title: Linda E. McMahon Student Commons
cards.subtitle: Meet, study or attend a campus presentation
cards.notes: Make it a practical meetup point for a small group, a solo study session or a scheduled presentation; use the floors and services that fit your plan.
cards.short_summary: The Commons is documented as a campus crossroads with spaces for informal meetings, study and presentations.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says McMahon Commons supports meetings of friends, solo study sessions and full-house presentations.
cards.source_title: Linda E. McMahon Student Commons | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Some services and spaces may have separate access or reservation requirements.

cards.title: IDEA Lab
cards.subtitle: West Campus fabrication and prototyping
cards.notes: Bring a project idea and contact the lab before using specialized equipment; SHU notes materials can carry a cost even when lab use is free to its community.
cards.short_summary: An 11,000-square-foot makerspace for digital fabrication and advanced manufacturing.
cards.evidence_claim: SHU states that the IDEA Lab is free for the Sacred Heart community to use, except for materials, and is on the West Building’s first floor.
cards.access_notes: Located at SHU West Campus, West Building, first floor; contact the IDEA Lab about equipment and materials.

cards.title: Valentine Health & Recreation Center
cards.subtitle: Student recreation, fitness and intramurals
cards.notes: Choose one activity that matches your time window—track, climbing wall, fitness floor or another listed recreation feature—and check facility rules before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A three-story student recreation center with fitness, sport, climbing, spin, bowling and simulator spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart identifies the Valentine Health & Recreation Center as the home for student recreation and lists its sport court, climbing wall, fitness areas, studios, track, spin room, golf simulator and bowling alley.
cards.access_notes: The handbook says the center is available to all students; verify current recreation access and hours.

cards.title: Chapel of the Holy Spirit
cards.subtitle: A campus-center space for reflection
cards.notes: Pause in the sanctuary or its smaller meditation and private-prayer spaces, and be mindful of any worship service or program taking place.
cards.short_summary: The chapel sits between the academic building and Ryan Matura Library, opening onto the Quadrangle.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart describes the Chapel of the Holy Spirit as central to campus and notes meditation and private-prayer spaces alongside its main sanctuary.
cards.source_title: Chapel of the Holy Spirit | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Respect services and quiet reflection; confirm public access with Campus Ministry if needed.

cards.title: Ryan Matura Library Water Wall
cards.subtitle: The library–chapel edge of the Quad
cards.notes: Use the water wall as a recognizable outdoor pause point while moving between the library and Chapel; keep walkways clear for others crossing the Quad.
cards.short_summary: A stone water wall outside the library that faces the Chapel of the Holy Spirit across the Quad.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart states that its water wall is outside Ryan Matura Library and creates a dialogue with the Chapel of the Holy Spirit across the Quad.
cards.access_notes: Outdoor campus feature; observe posted campus access guidance.

cards.entity_name: Edgerton Center for the Performing Arts
cards.title: Edgerton Center for the Performing Arts
cards.subtitle: A venue for SHU performing arts
cards.notes: Look for a student performance or program listing, then plan arrival around the posted start time and venue guidance instead of assuming drop-in access.
cards.short_summary: SHU lists the Edgerton Center among the university’s performing-arts facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart’s Music at SHU page identifies the Edgerton Center for the Performing Arts as a university arts facility and says its performing-arts programs are open to students across majors.
cards.source_title: Music at SHU | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Events may require registration or tickets; consult the current event listing.

cards.title: Art & Design Student Lounge & Library
cards.subtitle: West Campus study and art-book browsing
cards.notes: If you are using Art & Design facilities, settle in with class material or browse the gallery’s books; confirm department access before planning a group session.
cards.short_summary: A furnished lounge and library where students can study or browse books in the Art & Design Gallery.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says the Art & Design Student Lounge & Library provides students chairs, tables and a bean bag for studying or browsing Art & Design Gallery books.
cards.source_title: Facilities & Studio Spaces | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Confirm eligibility and access with the Art & Design department.

cards.title: Art & Design Mac Lab
cards.subtitle: Digital-design project workspace
cards.notes: Use the lab for an assigned design, animation or web project, and check with Art & Design staff about workstation availability and applicable access rules.
cards.short_summary: A department Mac lab for digital design, web design, animation and motion-graphics work.
cards.evidence_claim: Sacred Heart says the Art & Design Mac Lab gives students space to explore digital design, web design, animation and motion graphics, with additional iMacs in the annex for projects.
cards.source_title: Facilities & Studio Spaces | Sacred Heart University
cards.access_notes: Confirm eligibility, software access and lab availability with Art & Design.
